description: This file defines a final class `AclEntryModifiedStrategy` that extends `AbstractThingEventStrategy` to handle `AclEntryModified` events. It applies changes to a `ThingBuilder.FromCopy` object based on event data, specifically setting permissions.

classes.name: AclEntryModifiedStrategy
classes.description: Strategy class handling `AclEntryModified` events by updating the `ThingBuilder` with new ACL entry permissions.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the base method to apply an `AclEntryModified` event to a `ThingBuilder.FromCopy`, setting new ACL permissions.
